title: Sci-Fi
story: Blast off to the stars, one big-screen adventure at a time.

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A tall upright rocket: a white cylinder body with a pointed red nose cone, one round porthole window, and three symmetrical fins at the base, standing on a flat concrete launch pad.
cards.hero_colors: white body, red nose cone and fins, small blue porthole

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A perfectly round, symmetrical flying saucer: a wide silver disc with a glass dome on top and a ring of eight round lights around the rim.
cards.hero_colors: silver disc, light blue dome, small orange rim lights

cards.name: Ringed Planet
cards.subject: A perfectly round planet with one wide flat ring circling its middle, tilted slightly.
cards.hero_colors: orange planet, pale yellow ring, a small band of red stripe on the planet

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white astronaut helmet with a big round gold visor at the front and a thick neck ring at the bottom.
cards.hero_colors: white shell, gold visor, small blue neck ring

cards.name: Comet
cards.subject: A comet: a round icy rock head with a long curved glowing tail trailing behind it.
cards.hero_colors: icy white-blue head, pale blue tail, small orange glow at the head

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A boxy control console with a sloped top, a row of six round buttons, two round dials, and one wide flat screen.
cards.hero_colors: grey metal body, dark screen, small red buttons

cards.name: Teleport Pod
cards.subject: A teleport pod: an upright glass cylinder with a round metal base and a round metal cap, standing on a metal floor.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, silver base and cap, small cyan glow ring on the base

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A small moon rover: a boxy white body on six round wheels with a round dish fixed on top, driving on grey moon dust with craters.
cards.hero_colors: white body, black wheels, small yellow dish

cards.name: Moon Base
cards.subject: A moon base: a round white dome with a small round door, joined to a short tube-shaped tunnel on its side, resting on the ground.
cards.hero_colors: white dome, grey tunnel, small orange door

cards.name: Zero Gravity
cards.subject: The man in a round glass space helmet clings to a seat while the pig floats upward beside him with her curly tail spinning.
cards.hero_colors: white space suits, brown mustache, pink pig
cards.surface_or_setting: inside a bright spaceship cabin with a round window

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A perfectly round, symmetrical landed flying saucer: a silver disc with a glass dome on top, a ring of lights around the rim, and three short round feet under the disc.
cards.hero_colors: silver disc, green dome, small red rim lights

cards.name: Retro Rocket
cards.subject: A slim rocket with a pointed nose, a round porthole, and three curved fins at the base, standing upright on its fins.
cards.hero_colors: silver body, red fins, small blue porthole

cards.name: Ringed Planet
cards.subject: A perfectly round planet with one wide flat ring circling its middle, tilted slightly.
cards.hero_colors: purple planet, pale pink ring, small yellow band on the planet

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white astronaut helmet with a big round gold visor at the front and a thick neck ring at the bottom, resting on a table.
cards.hero_colors: white shell, gold visor, small red neck ring

cards.name: Lab Flask
cards.subject: A round-bottomed glass flask with a long narrow neck, filled with bubbling liquid up to the middle.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, bright green liquid, small orange cork

cards.name: Satellite
cards.subject: A satellite: a round silver ball body with four thin straight antenna rods fixed on one side, all swept back at the same angle.
cards.hero_colors: silver ball, dark grey rods, small gold dot on the ball

cards.name: Radio Dish
cards.subject: A radio telescope: a big round bowl dish tilted upward on a short thick cylinder base standing on the ground.
cards.hero_colors: white dish and base, grey inside the dish, small red tip at the center of the dish

cards.name: Space Capsule
cards.subject: A cone-shaped space capsule with a flat round bottom, a round hatch with a small window, resting upright on the sand.
cards.hero_colors: silver cone, dark heat shield bottom, small orange window frame

cards.name: Observatory
cards.subject: An observatory: a round white dome with a vertical slit opening, sitting on a short round tower on top of a grassy hill.
cards.hero_colors: white dome and tower, dark slit, small blue door

cards.name: Barn Visitors

cards.hero_colors: silver body, black wheels, small blue solar panel
